title: Killam Tank Filling Monday May Cause Low Water Pressure in Parts of Laredo
excerpt: Crews will begin filling the Killam Elevated Storage Tank early Monday morning, Nov. 16, and residents in parts of Laredo may see low water pressure or temporary fluctuations, the City of Laredo Utilities Department says.
content:
Crews will begin filling the Killam Elevated Storage Tank early Monday morning, November 16, the City of Laredo Utilities Department says, and residents and businesses in the surrounding area may experience low water pressure or temporary pressure fluctuations while the work is underway.

The areas that may be affected run west to east from International Boulevard to Bob Bullock Loop, and north to south from Orange Blossom Loop to East Del Mar Boulevard, according to the department.

The department says the work is part of its ongoing efforts to maintain proper water storage levels and keep water service reliable across the community.

Anyone with questions can call (956) 721-2010 or 3-1-1.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department, Nov. 13, 2026.
